question.name: The Statue That Judged Its Makers
question.text: During work on the great statue, a builder claims its expression changes depending on who looks at it.

choices.label: Declare the statue's expression a mystery.

a2.text: A child moves a polished shell, making the face seem to wink. The crowd roars with laughter.

a3.text: The workers interpret the face as a reminder to finish their task.

text_only.reason: rule 8: no game effect adds construction progress

b1.text: Villagers begin leaving gifts nearby, until the Chief reminds them the workers need supplies more.

b2.text: Two poets compose rival interpretations. The resulting argument becomes village entertainment.

b3.text: A worried builder confesses to carving the eyebrows unevenly. The village decides the flaw gives the statue character.
